verdicts.reason: The two candidates are almost pixel-identical, and both are broken. The 'SALE' letters have shrunk to tiny glyphs stuck at the bottom of oversized empty circles (the 'A' sits on a circle's lower edge, and in B it lands on the seam between circles). The column of circles is pushed against the right edge, 'NEW YEAR SPECIAL' is a tiny line off-centre at the top, and the decoration is just duplicated to fill the space, so the main message is lost and nothing has a clear hierarchy.
